status: AWAITING HUMAN REVIEW: expert guesses, not measured values. Style cues kept weak so that tone, missing news coverage and missing details together cannot reach the verdict threshold without a fact-check or source signal.

source_cred.rationale: Most forwarded messages carry no recognisable link; trusted and low sources are each a minority.

claim_true.rationale: Trusted sources are usually right, low-credibility ones rarely; an unknown source is a coin flip before other evidence. Columns: trusted, unknown, low.

fact_check.rationale: A refuting fact-check is much more likely for false claims, a supporting one for true claims; most claims have no coverage. Columns: claim true, claim false.

corroboration.rationale: A matching trusted-outlet headline is strong evidence for a true claim; a missing one is weak evidence, because the headline index only holds recent news. Columns: claim true, claim false.

sensational.rationale: False claims read slightly more alarmingly; a weak cue that must never decide a verdict alone. Columns: claim true, claim false.

specifics.rationale: True claims slightly more often carry checkable details; a weak cue that must never decide a verdict alone. Columns: claim true, claim false.
